'''Dreven''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[X1-Lioness TDL Nanny droid]], Dreven relayed a rumor that they had heard involving the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The rumor revolved around corporate executives and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officials reprogramming the droid into effective [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], primarily by adding a military-grade targeting package.<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
